construction_credit_policy: Title credits require reading the paper’s construction or existence argument and its attribution passages for this particular example. Citations, surveys, classification, stability, entropy, and use of an earlier construction do not by themselves confer construction credit. Independent or alternative constructions and numerical candidates are explicitly qualified. This selected-passage audit is not a proof verification or an exhaustive discovery history.
